description: Normalized postseason history for The Big Board, 2010–2025. One row per team appearance; shared contestId values form a matchup or placement event.

formatEras.label: Format I · Traditional Six-Team
formatEras.description: Six-team championship bracket with #1 and #2 receiving first-round byes. Seeds #3–#6 play in the opening round.

formatEras.label: Format II · Five-Team Play-In
formatEras.description: Five-team format designed to heavily reward regular-season performance and more consistently crown the league’s best team. #1 vs #2 played for a direct Super Bowl berth; #3, #4 and #5 met in a three-team elimination pod.

formatEras.label: Format III · Modern Six-Team + HFA
formatEras.description: Returned to six teams because Yahoo could not support the three-team matchup and manual tracking reduced entertainment value. Home Field Advantage was introduced to continue rewarding full-season strength.
